follows: Even now unbodied and invisible/Between us, floats our mighty Progeny. He then cancelled the
first of these two lines, replacing it with the second half of the received text of line 44 (which, unbodied
now), and cancelled our mighty Progeny to replace it with felt although unbeheld written above. There
is no punctuation in Nbk 9 after now at the end of line 44, and a comma is very firmly written in after
floats in line 45 (see BSM ix 384–5). In 1820 and 1839, the punctuation Mightier than either, which,
unbodied now,/Between us floats, fell, allhough unbeheld alters the sense. With 43–44 cp. Prometheus
